headline: OpenAI's new batch of math results draws mixed reports, concern
summary: OpenAI released a large batch of new mathematical results, largely produced by an unreleased frontier model responding to a single prompt. Reports differ on the batch's size, ranging from over 100 to 722 manuscripts. Some experts voiced concern that OpenAI is not adequately vetting results or making them accessible to the broader mathematical community.
